notes: Openings are canonical: the runtime window zone, glass overlay, curtain
pin, streak emitter and exterior backplate all resolve from these rects
Architecture paint passes must be composited through these holes so a
generated wall plate can never drift the authored camera contract.
Frames are the blockout's fixed casing rects; a treatment may recolor and
re-lit them but may not move them, because the openings they enclose are
the geometry every masked prop and the weather streak zone clip against.
